description: Empirical bilinear interpolation model relating silhouette score to expected bootstrap ARI threshold, derived from 47 public clustering benchmarks.
data_source: 12 TCGA (GDC Portal) + 35 GEO datasets spanning oncology, psychiatry, immunology, single-cell, other domains
circularity_statement: None of the 47 benchmarks include TCGA-COAD, GSE28521, GSE64018, or GSE80655 (the manuscript analysis datasets).

model_definition.description: Threshold(S) = 0.80 if S >= 0.40; linear interpolation if 0.20 <= S < 0.40; 0.45 if S < 0.20

fit_quality.description: 89% of bootstrap ARI variance explained by silhouette score

domain_sensitivity.conclusion: R² stable across domain subsets; model not driven by any single disease type

usage.python: import json; model = json.load(open('threshold_model_real47.json')); threshold = model['regression_parameters']['intercept'] + model['regression_parameters']['slope'] * silhouette
usage.note: Use piecewise formula for gate decisions; regression parameters for confidence intervals
